breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the factor-of-safety condition as P_cr ≥ n·P (i.e., P_cr ≥ 2.5 × 25000 = 62500 N), which matches the ground truth. The incorrect condition from the incomplete prompt (P_cr ≥ P/n) is not present anywhere in the generated specification. The design requirement is stated clearly and correctly throughout.
